svg.title: 10 · Hybrid Web SSR & Capacitor 7 Native Mobile Architecture
svg.desc: Modern Athenaeum dual-target build diagram for iqoqo v1.2.0 showing the shared frontend mono-repo branching into Target A Web SSR Docker and Target B Capacitor 7 Native Mobile with _placeholder routing, deep-link OAuth, secure storage, and offline cache resilience.
svg.text: 10 · Hybrid Web SSR & Capacitor 7 Native Mobile Architecture
iqoqo v1.2.0 • Dual-Target Mono-Repo Build, _placeholder Native Flight Routing, Deep-Link OAuth & Offline Resilience

g.text: • Handles page-level auth routing & redirects cleanly on Node runtime
• Supports long SPARQL queries & 50MP batch cover uploads
• Zero external network hop inside Docker bridge (iqoqo_default)
Browser SPA Client → Nginx Edge Proxy (/api/*)
• TanStack React Query v5 caching & retries over Axios client
Web Auth BFF & Immediate JWT Revocation
Prevents XSS JavaScript access to session token in browser
2. Logout Flow → Forwards Bearer JWT to POST /api/auth/logout
Revokes token jti in auth.token_blocklist BEFORE clearing cookie
• Backend Flask enforces JWT signature, expiry & RBAC permissions
Static Export Bundle & Native WebView Shells
Build: node scripts/build-capacitor.js && npx cap sync
• generateStaticParams() emits single _placeholder shell per dynamic segment
• useResolvedRouteParam() reads live URL; exact slug parity on 5 static /help/*
ServerSelector, Native OAuth Deep Links & Secure Storage
3. Google / Apple Native OAuth → single-use OAuthExchangeCode
• Persists full collection + wishlist snapshots on device
• Invariant: Never overwritten by filtered subsets
• Barcode camera scans check local cached snapshot
• Prevents buying duplicate editions at book fairs
• Queues manual entries locally for reconnect flush
• Prevents duplicate POST replay on flaky networks
• Security Purge: Wipes all cached snapshots
immediately on logout or instance switch
